name: cg_top_gainers
description:
Intended to list the 24-hour top gaining coins from CoinGecko: it calls coins/markets in USD, 20 coins, with order=percent_change_24h_desc.
Returns {coins: [{id, symbol, name, current_price, market_cap, price_change_percentage_24h, ...}]}, the same shape as cg_coin_markets.
Inputs: none.
That order value is not among CoinGecko's documented coins/markets orders (market_cap, volume, id), so check price_change_percentage_24h in the result rather than relying on the order. cg_top_losers is the counterpart.
Example: {}
No API key is sent (CoinGecko public API, rate-limited by CoinGecko); a failed call returns {"error": ...}.
